requested_outcome: Maintain a case-walled, source-bound and continuously verifiable internal digital twin of the controlled MPMB1435-26 bundle without any consequential external action.

seed_facts.proposition: The controlled core bundle has 54 pages and the registered exact byte hash.
seed_facts.proof_limit: Byte identity and page count do not prove the truth of every statement inside the source.

seed_facts.proposition: The controlled supplement has 33 pages, zero live form fields and the registered exact byte hash.
seed_facts.proof_limit: Technical integrity does not decide admissibility, weight or the merits.

seed_facts.proposition: The complete internal-review presentation contains 92 pages and remains an internal review artefact.
seed_facts.proof_limit: The composite does not replace the native source-controlled volumes.

seed_facts.proposition: The controlled matter remains on internal hold and has not been filed, served, emailed, published or settled by this workflow.
seed_facts.proof_limit: This is the recorded workflow state, not proof of any CCMA disposition.

seed_facts.proposition: The final written CCMA disposition or fresh separate set-down remains unverified in this control manifest.
seed_facts.proof_limit: No inference of closure, postponement, removal, consolidation or final determination may be drawn.

prohibited_inferences: A missing CCMA reply proves the matter is closed.
A paired notice proves formal consolidation with MPMB298-26.
A byte hash proves the truth, admissibility or legal weight of every statement in a document.
An unsigned or blank manager approval field proves approved remote work.
Engineering completion grants filing, service, sending, publication or settlement authority.

rollback.method: Restore the last verified matter-twin and value-ledger checkpoint; preserve superseded records and release receipts.
